scheme_name: Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The worker must be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year
The worker should have completed three years of membership in the fund
The worker should be remitting regular contributions to the fund
benefits_summary: Loan of ₹5,000 for the purchase of tools.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
